sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head in dorsal view very dark along the frontal margin and the anterior corners, the anterior three-quarters of the vertex almost black-chestnut, grading into chestnut brown and becoming rusty orange to pale yellow posteriorly; in lateral view the anterior dorsal region almost black, abruptly becoming chestnut brown below and pale yellow at the eye spot and below the occipital foramen. Mandibles chestnut brown. Anterior margin of the pronotum chestnut brown, posterior margin pale yellow. Head in dorsal view abruptly truncate anteriorly; the frontal margin forming a rim around several undulations on the frons. Head widest behind the frontal margin, gradually narrowing towards the occiput. The frontal margin is fused with the anterior corners and the postclypeus into a pentagonal frame occupying the whole frontal aspect. In lateral view the margins of the frons and of the occiput form an acute angle of about 60 degrees. Vertex with broad striae and several stout undulations; anterior corners very broad and shallow; genal angles reduced to small tubercles in front of the antennal sockets. Mandibles short, hump-shaped, slightly curved forwards, the tip of the right mandible lying below the tip of the left mandible, both tips below the labrum in frontal view. Labrum short, transparent, tongue-shaped. Anteclypeus white; postclypeus trapezoidal, with undulate wrinkles. Eye spots large, narrowly oval. Antennae moniliform, 10 to 12-segmented, segment formula 2>3=4=5<6. Each tibia with three apical spurs, formula 3:3:3. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly incised, slightly narrower than the head capsule.
